title: Soil Carbon Stocks and Radiocarbon Profiles in Three Agricultural Systems of California’s Central Valley

workbook.note_revision: Current endpoint Welch table and observed stock summaries; raw measurements and native workbook features preserved.

selected_methods.annual_root: Corrected Gamma full interaction: 1000 * (root mass in g + 0.00017 g) / volume in cm3. Half/original/double sensitivity; six-test Holm results separate from unadjusted contrasts.
selected_methods.perennial_root: B_shift_gamma full interaction at 0–75 cm, recorded zeros retained; five constant scenarios, conditional residual diagnostics and predictive-floor checks.
selected_methods.nonroot: Six retained Type III Wald GLMMs for C concentration and bulk radiocarbon; supporting bulk-density models remain unchanged.
selected_methods.cumulative_C_stock: Welch endpoints: annual0–100, orchard0–75, hedgerow0–20/75; one core value per endpoint, unadjusted pointwise95% CI, Holm adjustment across all six hedgerow pairwise tests.

paper_reference_result_set: The author selected cumulative C-stock Welch endpoint comparisons using one value per core: annual fields 0–100 cm, orchards 0–75 cm, and hedgerows 0–20 and 0–75 cm. The six hedgerow pairwise p values are Holm-adjusted as one family. Table 1 separates unchanged non-stock Wald tests in panel A from eight stock endpoint comparisons in panel B. Figures 2–4c show observed means ±1 sample SE with no profile-model stock stars. All measurements, root/C-concentration/radiocarbon results and historical stock analyses are retained.
